title: Miami-based Coast Guard crews deploy for Hurricane Harvey Response efforts
description: Miami-based Coast Guard crews load a Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater HC-130 Hercules airplane with gear bags and board the airplane to deploy to Mobile to help out with Hurricane Harvey Response efforts, Monday, Aug. 28, 2017. The crews will be further deployed from Mobile to impacted areas in Texas to help with search and rescue efforts. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Jonathan Lally.
keywords: Miami, response, HC-130, Clearwater, MSST, Lally, Hercules, D7, 7th Coast Guard District, District Seven, Hurricane Harvey, Maritime Safety and Security Team Miami, Coast Guard
